form.label: GitHub Audit and Security - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for GitHub organization/enterprise audit and security JSON relay events. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures plus Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family IN ("repo","branch_rules") | stats count

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family IN ("sso_credential_authorization","token_app_access","audit_streaming","webhooks","ssh_certificate_authority","secret_scanning","security_alerts") | stats count

panel.title: Org/team, enterprise admin, and Actions admin

search.query: index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family IN ("org_membership","enterprise_admin","actions") | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by GitHub audit family

search.query: index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(github_audit_family,"github_audit") | timechart count by family
index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(github_audit_family,"github_audit") | stats count by family | sort -count
index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by action | sort -count | head 25
index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval github_user=coalesce(actor, user, src_user) | stats count by github_user | sort -count | head 20
index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | eval actor_country=coalesce(src, 'actor_location.country_code') | stats count by actor_country | sort -count | head 20
index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by org business repo object github_audit_family status | sort -count | head 50

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family IN ("sso_credential_authorization","token_app_access","audit_streaming","webhooks","ssh_certificate_authority","secret_scanning","security_alerts") | table _time host github_audit_family action actor user org repo token_id oauth_credential_type managed_token_scopes audit_log_stream_id audit_log_stream_enabled audit_log_stream_sink new_s3_bucket old_s3_bucket secrets_updated hook_id events name invitee inviter permission public_repo ssh_certificate_authority_id fingerprint user_agent request_id alert_number secret_type alert_state severity security_advisory_ghsa_id status signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family IN ("actions","branch_rules") | table _time host action actor org repo branch secret_name object status alert_number alert_state severity marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ github_audit_family="enterprise_admin" | table _time host action actor user org business enterprise_role permission operation_type user_agent request_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host github_audit_family | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=gitops sourcetype="github:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host github_audit_family action actor user org business repo object status enterprise_role audit_log_stream_id audit_log_stream_enabled audit_log_stream_sink new_s3_bucket old_s3_bucket secrets_updated hook_id events name invitee inviter permission public_repo ssh_certificate_authority_id fingerprint oauth_credential_type user_agent request_id signature signature_id src marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
